title: thelypteris serra
intro: Thelypteris serra, commonly known as the Serra Spleenwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Thelypteris serra contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
